title: Parable: Invitation by the Explaining Master and Conduct of the Two Groups

questions.question: In the palace speech, what does the king want people to do first about him?
questions.answer: Know him and learn about him.

questions.question: What should people do when they see the beautiful decorations and skilled work?
questions.answer: Value the work and admire it.

questions.question: The gifts and good things show the king’s love. How should people answer that love?
questions.answer: By loving him and obeying him.

questions.question: What should people do because the king shows kindness and care through his gifts?
questions.answer: Thank him and respect him.

questions.question: Why does the king show his great beauty and perfection?
questions.answer: So people will want to see him and seek his pleasure.

questions.question: What do the special marks on each artwork show?
questions.answer: That each thing belongs to him and is made by him.

questions.question: What should people understand about the king after seeing those special marks?
questions.answer: He is one, unique, and has no equal.

questions.question: After the speech, into how many groups did the people split?
questions.answer: Two groups.

questions.question: What was good about the first group before they listened more closely?
questions.answer: They understood themselves, were smart, and had good hearts.

questions.question: When the first group saw the palace wonders, what did they realize about them?
questions.answer: That they were important and not pointless.

questions.question: What made the first group want to learn more?
questions.answer: They were curious about the secret and meaning of the palace.

questions.question: How did the first group know where to find the answers?
questions.answer: They heard the teacher speaking and understood that he had the answers.

questions.question: How did the first group speak to the teacher?
questions.answer: Politely and with respect.

questions.question: What did the teacher do for the first group?
questions.answer: He told them the message and explained it.

questions.question: How did the first group respond to what they heard?
questions.answer: They listened well, accepted it, and benefited from it.

questions.question: What did the first group do after learning the king’s wishes?
questions.answer: They acted the way the king wanted.

questions.question: What reward did the first group receive?
questions.answer: They were invited to another wonderful high palace and given lasting happiness.

questions.question: What was wrong with the second group’s minds and hearts?
questions.answer: Their minds were spoiled and their hearts were dark.

questions.question: What did the second group pay attention to instead of the palace meanings?
questions.answer: Only the tasty food.

questions.question: How did the second group treat the teacher’s guidance?
questions.answer: They ignored it and would not listen.

questions.question: What did the second group do with drinks that were not for them to use that way?
questions.answer: They drank them and became drunk.

questions.question: How did the second group behave after that?
questions.answer: They shouted and disturbed the other guests.

questions.question: Why were the second group arrested?
questions.answer: They broke the rules and behaved badly.

questions.question: Where were the second group taken?
questions.answer: To a prison fit for such rude people.

questions.question: Why did the teacher say the king built and showed this palace to the people?
questions.answer: To let them know him.

questions.question: What are people supposed to do when they notice the king’s skill in the palace?
questions.answer: Appreciate it and admire it.

questions.question: The many blessings show what feeling from the king?
questions.answer: Love, kindness, and care.

questions.question: What is a right response to the king’s blessings?
questions.answer: Love him, obey him, and thank him.

questions.question: Why does the speech say the king displays wonderful beauty in his works?
questions.answer: So people will long to see him and try to please him.

questions.question: What do the signs placed on all the artworks teach about the maker?
questions.answer: That he alone made them and they belong to him.

questions.question: What truth about the king should people accept?
questions.answer: That he is one and has no partner or equal.

questions.question: What happened to the crowd after the teacher spoke?
questions.answer: They separated into two groups.

questions.question: What kind of people were in the first group?
questions.answer: People with understanding, intelligence, and sound hearts.

questions.question: What did the first group decide when they looked at the palace?
questions.answer: That something very important was going on.

questions.question: Did the first group think the palace was just for fun?
questions.answer: No. They knew it had a real purpose.

questions.question: What question was in the minds of the first group?
questions.answer: They wanted to know its secret and meaning.

questions.question: Why did they go to the teacher?
questions.answer: They understood he could explain the mysteries.

questions.question: What does their greeting and request show about their manners?
questions.answer: They were respectful and humble.

questions.question: How did listening to the teacher help the first group?
questions.answer: They learned the message and gained much benefit.

questions.question: What connection is shown between listening and doing?
questions.answer: After they listened and accepted, they obeyed properly.

questions.question: Why was the king pleased with the first group?
questions.answer: Because they had good manners and acted rightly.

questions.question: What blessing did the king give them because he was pleased?
questions.answer: A special lofty palace and never-ending happiness.

questions.question: What controlled the second group when they entered the palace?
questions.answer: Their bad desires.

questions.question: What part of the palace took all of the second group’s attention?
questions.answer: The food.

questions.question: How did the second group act toward the teacher and his helpers?
questions.answer: They shut out the guidance and warnings.

questions.question: What comparison is used for the way they ate?
questions.answer: They ate like animals.

questions.question: What came after they drank what was not meant for that use?
questions.answer: They became drunk and noisy.

questions.question: What final result came from their rude behavior?
questions.answer: The king’s soldiers seized them and put them in prison.

questions.question: According to the speech, what does the king want from the people when he shows them the palace?
questions.answer: He wants them to recognize him.

questions.question: What should people feel about the king’s works of art?
questions.answer: Admiration.

questions.question: If the king shows love through blessings, what should people give back?
questions.answer: Love and obedience.

questions.question: If the king shows mercy and kindness through gifts, what should people offer?
questions.answer: Thanks and respect.

questions.question: What hope should rise in people when they see the king’s great beauty in his works?
questions.answer: A wish to see him and be accepted by him.

questions.question: Why are special signs placed on every crafted thing?
questions.answer: To show the king made them himself and that they are his.

questions.question: What does the speech teach about the king’s uniqueness?
questions.answer: No one is like him or equal to him.

questions.question: After hearing words like these, what did the people do?
questions.answer: They became two different groups.

questions.question: What inner qualities helped the first group respond well?
questions.answer: Self-understanding, intelligence, and good hearts.

questions.question: What was the first group’s first strong thought about the palace wonders?
questions.answer: That they were serious and meaningful.

questions.question: What feeling led the first group to search for answers?
questions.answer: Wonder.

questions.question: What showed the first group that the teacher had the key to understanding?
questions.answer: His speech explained the mysteries.

questions.question: What did the first group ask the teacher to do?
questions.answer: Tell them what the king wanted them to know.

questions.question: How did the first group listen?
questions.answer: Carefully.

questions.question: What three good steps did the first group take after listening?
questions.answer: They accepted, benefited, and obeyed.

questions.question: What kind of reward matched the first group’s good manners?
questions.answer: A wonderful high palace and lasting joy.

questions.question: What was the condition of the second group on the inside?
questions.answer: Their thinking was spoiled and their hearts were deadened.

questions.question: What did the second group choose instead of paying attention to the palace’s lessons?
questions.answer: They chased food and pleasure.

questions.question: How is their ignoring of truth described with their eyes and ears?
questions.answer: They would not look at the good and would not hear guidance.

questions.question: What bad choice made their behavior even worse after eating?
questions.answer: They drank something not meant for that purpose.

questions.question: How did their actions affect other guests?
questions.answer: They disturbed and upset them.

questions.question: In what way did the second group break proper conduct?
questions.answer: They disrespected the rules of the palace owner.

questions.question: What punishment fit their rude actions?
questions.answer: They were arrested and thrown into prison.

questions.question: What is the main message the teacher gives first about the palace owner?
questions.answer: The owner wants people to know him.

questions.question: What should people do when they see the beauty and skill in the palace?
questions.answer: Appreciate it and let that bring love for the owner.

questions.question: How should people answer the love shown in the many blessings?
questions.answer: By loving the owner and obeying him.

questions.question: What is the right response to the owner’s kindness and mercy?
questions.answer: To be thankful and respectful.

questions.question: Why does the owner show his high beauty in his works?
questions.answer: To draw people to him.

questions.question: What do the seal and mark on each work prove?
questions.answer: Each work is specially his.

questions.question: What should people believe about the owner after seeing all those signs?
questions.answer: He is alone in his greatness and has no equal.

questions.question: What made the first group ready to understand the palace rightly?
questions.answer: They had good sense and upright hearts.

questions.question: What did the first group understand about the amazing things in the palace?
questions.answer: They were not made for no reason.

questions.question: What did the first group want to discover?
questions.answer: The hidden meaning behind it all.

questions.question: Who helped the first group move from wondering to understanding?
questions.answer: The master teacher.

questions.question: How did the first group show adab, or good manners, to the teacher?
questions.answer: They greeted him with peace and asked politely.

questions.question: What did the teacher repeat for them?
questions.answer: The message about the owner and what he wanted.

questions.question: What happened because the first group accepted the teaching?
questions.answer: They gained much good from it.

questions.question: What did the first group do that pleased the king?
questions.answer: They behaved the way he wanted.

questions.question: What was given to the first group after the king was pleased with them?
questions.answer: A special, higher palace and happiness that stays.

questions.question: Why did the second group fail to understand the palace?
questions.answer: Their bad desires took over them.

questions.question: What did the second group care about most?
questions.answer: Eating the delicious food.

questions.question: What did they ignore besides the teacher’s words?
questions.answer: The warnings from his students too.

questions.question: What does their eating and sleeping suggest about their behavior?
questions.answer: They acted carelessly and like animals.

questions.question: What happened after they drank what they should not have used that way?
questions.answer: They got drunk.

questions.question: How did the second group treat the rest of the guests?
questions.answer: They bothered them with loud shouting.

questions.question: What was the end for the second group?
questions.answer: They were taken away by soldiers and put in prison.

questions.question: In the announcement, what did the teacher say the king wants through building the palace?
questions.answer: He wants to be known by the people.

questions.question: What should the people do after seeing the king’s beautiful decorations?
questions.answer: Love him by honoring his skillful work.

questions.question: What do the blessings in the palace show about the king’s feelings toward the people?
questions.answer: He cares for them and loves them.

questions.question: Which two actions are named as a right answer to those blessings?
questions.answer: Obeying and thanking.

questions.question: Why does the king let people see signs of his great beauty?
questions.answer: So they will want to see him and gain his favor.

questions.question: What lesson comes from the special sign on every crafted thing?
questions.answer: It all comes from one owner and maker.

questions.question: What should people reject when they understand the king correctly?
questions.answer: The idea that anyone is like him or shares his place.

questions.question: What happened after the teacher finished speaking to the people?
questions.answer: They became two groups.

questions.question: Why was the first group able to notice the truth of the palace?
questions.answer: They had insight, intelligence, and sound hearts.

questions.question: What did the first group say in meaning when they saw the palace?
questions.answer: That something very important was happening.

questions.question: What false idea did the first group avoid?
questions.answer: That the palace was useless or only a game.

questions.question: What led them to the teacher?
questions.answer: Their wish to understand the hidden meaning.

questions.question: What did the first group believe about the teacher before asking him?
questions.answer: That he was truthful and exact.

questions.question: What does this show about the role of the teacher in the palace?
questions.answer: He is needed to explain everything properly.

questions.question: What did the first group do with the teacher’s message?
questions.answer: They listened, accepted it, and benefited.

questions.question: What result came from their obedience?
questions.answer: The king was pleased with them.

questions.question: What did the king give them because of that pleasure?
questions.answer: Another special palace and lasting happiness.

questions.question: What weakened the second group’s ability to respond well?
questions.answer: Their corrupted minds and dead hearts.

questions.question: What did they focus on instead of the palace’s lessons and beauty?
questions.answer: Their stomachs and pleasure.

questions.question: What does it mean that they shut out guidance and warnings?
questions.answer: They refused to learn.

questions.question: What happened when they used certain drinks the wrong way?
questions.answer: They became drunk.

questions.question: How did drunkenness change their behavior?
questions.answer: It made them loud and disorderly.

questions.question: Why was their behavior especially wrong in the palace?
questions.answer: It went against the owner’s rules.

questions.question: What was a fitting ending for people who behaved that way?
questions.answer: Being jailed.

questions.question: What does the palace owner want people to understand about him from the palace?
questions.answer: That he is the one behind it and they should know him.

questions.question: How should people respond to the owner’s beautiful and careful work?
questions.answer: By admiring it and becoming beloved to him.

questions.question: What should people do because the owner shows love through many blessings?
questions.answer: Love him and obey him.

questions.question: What should people do because the owner shows mercy and kindness?
questions.answer: Thank him with respect.

questions.question: What desire should the owner’s displayed beauty awaken in people?
questions.answer: A strong wish to see him and be near his pleasure.

questions.question: What do the unique marks on each artwork tell the people?
questions.answer: Every piece is his own work.

questions.question: What belief about the owner follows from that?
questions.answer: He is one, unmatched, and independent.

questions.question: Into how many groups did the visitors divide?
questions.answer: Two.

questions.question: What kind of character did the first group have?
questions.answer: Good understanding and good hearts.

questions.question: What wise conclusion did the first group make when seeing the palace?
questions.answer: That it had an important purpose.

questions.question: What did they want to unlock or understand?
questions.answer: Its secrets.

questions.question: How did they find the one who could explain those secrets?
questions.answer: They heard the teacher’s message.

questions.question: What respectful action did they take before asking for help?
questions.answer: They greeted the teacher with peace.

questions.question: What did they ask the teacher for?
questions.answer: The message given to him by their lord.

questions.question: What shows that the first group were teachable?
questions.answer: They listened closely and accepted the teaching.

questions.question: What did they do after learning the right way?
questions.answer: They followed it.

questions.question: What happy ending came to the first group?
questions.answer: They were welcomed to a higher palace and made happy forever.

questions.question: What ruled the second group when they entered the palace?
questions.answer: Their sinful desires.

questions.question: What part of the palace pulled their attention away from everything else?
questions.answer: The delicious food.

questions.question: How did the second group treat the truths being taught in the palace?
questions.answer: They ignored them.

questions.question: What did they do that showed they had no self-control?
questions.answer: They overate, slept, and drank wrongly.

questions.question: How did their conduct hurt others around them?
questions.answer: They upset the other guests.

questions.question: What does their punishment teach about bad manners and disobedience?
questions.answer: Bad behavior brings a just punishment.

questions.question: Where did the second group finally end up?
questions.answer: In prison.
